name: showcase-hybrid-kind-cloud-profile
spec:
    activities:
        - command:
            arguments:
                - -c
                - |
                  set -eu
                  printf 'akoflow-kind-to-gcp\n' > handoff.txt
                  test -s handoff.txt

                  printf '%s\n' '{"name":"produce","status":"completed"}' > stage-produce.json
            entrypoint: sh
          cpuLimit: "0.1"
          memoryLimit: 16Mi
          name: produce
          runtime: showcase-hybrid-kind-cloud-profile-local
        - command:
            arguments:
                - -c
                - |
                  set -eu
                  test -s handoff.txt
                  grep -qx 'akoflow-kind-to-gcp' handoff.txt
                  printf 'cloud consumed: ' > receipt.txt
                  cat handoff.txt >> receipt.txt

                  printf '%s\n' '{"name":"consume","status":"completed"}' > stage-consume.json
            entrypoint: sh
          cpuLimit: "0.1"
          dependsOn:
            - produce
          memoryLimit: 16Mi
          name: consume
          runtime: showcase-hybrid-kind-cloud-profile-local
    dataDependencies:
        - consumerActivity: consume
          logicalName: handoff.txt
          producerActivity: produce
          sizeBytes: 20
    image: busybox@sha256:73aaf090f3d85aa34ee199857f03fa3a95c8ede2ffd4cc2cdb5b94e566b11662
    namespace: examples
